scope: Gemma4 E2B only; bounded training-recipe diagnosis, no final-test evaluation

memorization.other_tasks: Four examples for each of eight other core tasks
memorization.success: At least97% training-set tie-aware accuracy, at least90% financial pairs both correct; native SFT additionally at least95% unconstrained top-one answer tokens in the supplied candidate codes
memorization.pilot_gate: Proceed if either higher-LR code or native SFT arm passes. Otherwise finish with blocked_memorization, preserve all results and stop GPU.

pilot.controls: 144 candidate permutations,144 anonymous candidate mappings,16 financial predicate reversals; evaluation only
pilot.learning_rate_schedule: 32-step warmup then cosine decay to10% of peak
pilot.training_order: Identical fixed shuffled example order, effective batch8, deterministic choice-order permutations with correctly preserved semantic references
pilot.evaluation: Initial and scheduled development metrics, financial AUC/pair discrimination, routing utility versus training-only fixed router, native safety misses/false blocks; selected-checkpoint label-binding controls
pilot.checkpoint_selection: Keep highest development aggregate for each arm for controlled reporting, but do not declare a deployable winner by aggregate alone

acceptance_diagnostics.safety: Report false blocks and unsafe recall separately; no acceptance from accuracy alone

shared_training.initialization: Fresh pinned base for every arm; no phase4 checkpoint continuation; reset LoRA initialization RNG immediately before attaching adapters
shared_training.precision: BF16 frozen base, FP32 LoRA; code head FP32 as in phase4; native SFT retains native BF16 frozen LM head
shared_training.code_head_learning_rate: 2.5 times backbone rate, preserving phase4 ratio
shared_training.native_sft: Native full-vocabulary next-token loss for the single answer-code completion; native LM head frozen as in standard LoRA. Set-aware extension accepts all native routing ties. No reasoning tokens or EOS are supervised in this classification baseline.
shared_training.candidate_loss: logsumexp over allowed codes minus logsumexp accepted codes; logk variant additionally divides by log(candidate count)
shared_training.native_sft_loss: logsumexp over full native vocabulary minus logsumexp accepted answer-code tokens; equivalent to one-token completion-only causal LM CE for singleton references
shared_training.task_weights: Pilot only: equal domains and equal tasks per domain using inverse training-count weights, identical across arms
shared_training.memorization_weights: No domain/task weights or logk normalization; fixed candidate order
shared_training.attention: Native causal SDPA; TF32 disabled; cuDNN SDPA disabled

persistence: Private HF checkpoints, optimizer/RNG and per-case development records; GitHub code/manifests/aggregates. Raw contexts transferred directly to owned Colab, not published.
claim_scope: These are training and development diagnostics. Phase4 core/transfer test cases are not loaded. A future superiority claim needs a separately sealed disjoint test after recipe selection.
